Question: A source emits a sound from one medium with a certain velocity, intensity, frequency and wavelength. When the sound exits the first medium and enters a denser medium, all of the following changes EXCEPT:

Options: 
A. tone
B. amplitude
C. wavelength
D. direction
E. pitch
F. frequency
G. resonance
H. volume
I. intensity
J. velocity

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
